acceptanceCriteria: A decision amends 0415 for the -k flag and the schedule.
A dispatched or scheduled Release gates run whose full-gate fails one step still runs every later GATE_STEPS step, and the job still fails.
The scheduled run checks out main's head and names its artifacts with the nightly label.
body: Context: 1.0.0-rc.2 needed four candidates (0ae3f88d, da78c157, 7a83f52d, b7b21205); each of the first three failed only the hosted macos-15 full-gate job. make gate stops at the first failed step, so go-vet, cross-vet, interop-gate and every later step never ran on hosted macOS for those candidates. PR CI is ubuntu-only and release-gates.yml runs only on owner dispatch, so four macOS-only defects that landed after rc.1 (V1-0841, V1-0842, V1-0843, V1-0846) were first seen at release time. Expected: one hosted run reports every failing gate step, and macOS regressions surface within a day of landing. Change: full-gate runs make -k gate (exit status unchanged: non-zero on any failure, receipt only when every step passes), and the workflow also runs on a nightly schedule against main. Amends decision 0415; a .github/ change merges only after an admin posts ci-control-plane success (decision 0390).
title: Release gates: keep the hosted full gate going past a failed step and run it nightly on main
